title.narrative: The total number of projects for 2025 is 193 so far, comprising 88 carried over from 2024 and 105 newly initiated projects for 2025. To date, 33 projects have been completed. Construction of four check dams has commenced across three zones, with two nearing completion. A total of 32 extenders have been mobilized and are actively continuing their assignments. Additionally, the Third-Party Monitoring (TPM) contract is currently under process.
